curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: identify words with the sounds /f/, /n/, /h/, /ɒ/ and / ɔː/ in preparation for reading

interactions.retryHint: Press your lip and teeth together: fff.

interactions.prompt: Match each beginning sound to a word.
interactions.retryHint: Say each word slowly and listen to its first sound.

interactions.prompt: Which word has the short /ɒ/ sound heard in hot?
interactions.retryHint: Listen to the middle of h-o-t.

interactions.prompt: Which word has the long /ɔː/ sound heard in storm?
interactions.feedback: Right! Storm carries the long /ɔː/ sound.

interactions.prompt: Read: Hana has a fan on a hot day. Which pair begins with /h/ and /f/?
interactions.feedback: Excellent! Hana starts /h/ and fan starts /f/.
interactions.retryHint: Find one h word, then one f word.
Check the first three beginnings, then short o and long aw.
